title: Purchase Order
context: Material Management › Procure-to-Pay (PO Flow) › Purchase Order

cards.title: Form architecture, table bindings, and data layers of fPurchaseOrder
cards.body:
fPurchaseOrder is a primary transaction interface residing within the Material Management module.
Header attributes map to Purchase.PMPurchaseOrder while line items bind to Purchase.PMPOIndentDetail.
Associated expense splits and freight routes persist in Purchase.PMPOExpense and Purchase.PMPORoute.
Tax line calculations write to the shared tax repository Finance.TDCTransactionDetail.
Optimistic locking relies on ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy columns evaluated during update execution.
UI section controls encapsulate distinct child datasets loaded asynchronously upon user navigation.
Shared custom fields interface through masterdata.customfieldssave during the primary transaction commit.
Lookup controls populate via GlobalData.VendorLocationSelect and Purchase.PMPOFillValues procedures.
Atomic transaction scopes ensure header and child records roll back completely on execution failure.
Entity state management coordinates with document status flags Initial, Release, and Authorized.
Database triggers prevent direct row updates when DocumentStatus is marked Authorized in the header.
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity against item, vendor, and location master tables.
The data layer executes parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities during persistence.
Transactions run under read-committed snapshot isolation to avoid deadlocks during concurrent access.
Audit triggers record prior row states to historical archive tables before modification executes.
Header and child entity states synchronize through explicit transaction boundaries managed by the framework.

cards.title: Stored procedure bindings for load, save, delete, and lookup operations
cards.body:
All backend operations on fPurchaseOrder execute through dedicated stored procedures in the Purchase schema.
Record searches execute through Purchase.PMPOSearchData returning paginated document headers.
Selected records load via Purchase.PMPOFillValues and Purchase.PMPOFillValuesDependent.
Indent line details populate through Purchase.PMPOIndentDetail and Purchase.PMPOGetIndentItemDetail.
Freight logistics parameters are retrieved through the stored procedure Purchase.PMPOFreightOrderDetail.
Quality parameters linked to item lines load through the routine Purchase.GetSpecificationDetail.
Record deletion invokes Purchase.PMPODelete which enforces child dependency validation before row removal.
Custom validation routines execute through the external procedure ODTPurchaseOrder.ProcedureName.
Account assignments resolve dynamically using Purchase.PMPOFillValuesAccountAssignment.
All stored procedures return structured error codes handled by the application exception layer.
Transaction commits execute within serialized isolation levels to ensure consistent record persistence.
Audit logging procedures capture user credentials and execution timestamps across all data modifications.
Procedure parameters pass structured table-valued parameters for bulk detail line persistence.
Execution plans are cached by the relational database engine to optimize throughput under heavy load.
Error handling blocks implement explicit transaction rollback upon detecting database exceptions.
Return codes communicate operation results back to the presentation layer for user status display.
Diagnostic logging captures stored procedure execution metrics for performance monitoring.

cards.title: Validation logic and Boolean condition triggers in fPurchaseOrder
cards.body:
Form validation routines evaluate business rules prior to executing persistence routines in the database.
ValidityDate < DocumentDate raises a blocking validation error stopping transaction execution.
FromLocationId == ToLocationId triggers validation refusal during transportation route configuration.
POQty > BalanceIndentQty triggers an exception preventing line item over-allocation against source indents.
NegativeTolerance >= 100 or NegativeTolerance >= POQty aborts transaction processing.
GST validation evaluates CompanyStateId against VendorStateId to enforce CGST/SGST versus IGST.
UnitRate <= 0 triggers validation failure unless zero-rate flags are explicitly configured.
Missing HSN codes on item masters trigger HSNSAC Code is not defined exceptions.
Concurrent edits trigger optimistic locking errors when ModifiedDate mismatches database state.
Validation checks execute sequentially within client validation before invoking backend procedures.
State transitions verify user permission mappings against authorization group tables before updating status.
Failure at any validation stage rolls back temporary variables and returns structured diagnostic messages.
Client validation executes prior to server invocation to minimize redundant network roundtrips.
Server procedures re-evaluate all Boolean conditions to ensure data integrity against direct API calls.
Validation failures raise structured SQL exceptions with specific error numbers and contextual parameters.
Rollback handlers reverse all intermediate variable states when any rule triggers an exception.

cards.title: Child record mutation logic and status cascading mechanisms
cards.body:
Transaction modifications execute a delete-and-reinsert pattern for detail line items in the database.
Existing records in Purchase.PMPOIndentDetail are cleared and regenerated from current inputs.
Cascade routines update parent indent balances by decrementing reserved quantities on indent rows.
When an order is created against a Comparative Statement, CS booking balances are updated.
Authorization triggers status transitions in source indent lines from Open to Consumed.
Cancelling an order line invokes balance restoration procedures returning quantities to indents.
Detail replacement executes within a database transaction to prevent orphan records upon execution failure.
Audit logging records prior states to historical tracking tables before row regeneration.
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity against item and vendor masters.
Cascade handlers ensure inventory demand staging tables reflect current net requirements accurately.
Line item replacement commits synchronously with document header updates within a single transaction.
This mutation logic guarantees that parent document balances stay synchronized with child purchase orders.
Detail row regeneration calculates sequential line numbers to maintain consistent grid display order.
Parent record balance recalculation queries execute within the primary atomic transaction boundary.
Audit log tables record previous quantity states to provide differential tracking across updates.
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity against item, vendor, and location master tables.

cards.title: Authorization group schema, multi-level approvals, and state locks
cards.body:
fPurchaseOrder implements a state machine governed by masterdata.mAuthorizationGroup tables.
Authorization groups define approval hierarchies stored in masterdata.mAuthorizationGroupUser.
Intermediate approvals insert audit records into Purchase.PMPOApprovalHistory.
Intermediate sign-offs maintain DocumentStatus as Release without granting final authorization.
Only users mapped to the terminal hierarchy level can transition status to Authorized.
Direct status updates to Authorized bypass approval procedures and are blocked by server triggers.
Authorized records become read-only at database level via update-prevention triggers.
Document amendments create linked records in Purchase.PMPOAmendment maintaining revision IDs.
State transitions dispatch notification emails through system background queue tables.
Audit history logs capture approver user IDs, approval decisions, comments, and action timestamps.
State transitions execute within serialized transactions to prevent concurrent conflicting authorizations.
This approval framework enforces strict regulatory compliance and financial segregation of duties.
State transitions evaluate user security roles against authorization matrix tables dynamically.
Direct database updates attempting to alter DocumentStatus to Authorized are intercepted by triggers.
Notification services poll approval queue tables asynchronously to dispatch alert emails.
Serialized transaction blocks prevent race conditions during concurrent approval submissions.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.

cards.title: Referential integrity constraints and backend deletion barriers
cards.body:
Backend deletion procedures evaluate foreign key dependencies across operational schemas.
Purchase.PMPODelete queries Inventory.IGRNMain to detect linked material receipt notes in stores.
The presence of linked Gate Entry or GRN records triggers foreign key dependency errors.
Queries against Finance.fAdvanceRequest block deletion if advance vouchers reference the PO ID.
Active bank guarantees in Finance.fBankGuarantee create blocking integrity constraints.
Existing revision rows in Purchase.PMPOAmendment prevent deletion of the parent order.
Deletion handlers execute within explicit transaction blocks with rollback on violation.
Audit tables capture deletion attempts, user credentials, and machine IP addresses.
Soft-delete flags are set on specific line items when balances are closed manually by buyers.
Hard deletes are permitted only on unreferenced Initial status drafts by authorized users.
Referential integrity barriers protect historical procurement data from accidental administrative deletion.
Database triggers ensure child records in freight and expense tables purge synchronously on draft removal.
Referential integrity checks execute queries across dependent transaction tables before deletion commits.
Detected foreign references trigger structured constraint violations returned to the application interface.
Transaction rollback handlers ensure that partial deletions never leave orphaned records in child tables.
Audit tables log deletion attempts, user credentials, and machine IP addresses for security reviews.
